ai_overview.description: Google AI Overview (formerly SGE). Present only when Google shows an AI-generated answer at the top of the page. null when absent.

answer.description: The full AI-generated answer text, including any inline citation link text. null when the answer text was not present in the static HTML (dynamically loaded without scripts).
answer.example: För att få den mest exakta och aktuella väderprognosen för Nykyrka, Motala, rekommenderas att du besöker SMHIs webbplats.

citations.description: Sources cited inline within the AI answer text, in order of appearance.

sponsored_results.description: Paid/advertised results (Google Ads) shown on the page, in display order.

organic_results.description: Non-paid search results, in display order. Ad blocks are excluded.

faq_results.description: "People Also Ask" FAQ accordion items, in display order.

related_searches.description: Related search query strings shown at the bottom of the page.

ai_citation.description: A source cited inline in the AI Overview answer text.

position.description: 1-based position of this citation within the AI answer, in order of appearance.

title.description: The anchor text of the citation link as it appears in the AI answer.

domain.description: Hostname of the cited page, with leading www. stripped.

url.description: Full URL of the cited page.

advertiser.description: The advertiser name displayed above the ad title.

title.example: Linas Matkasse - Prova 2 veckor för 299 kr

description.description: The ad body text shown below the title.
description.example: Välj bland hundratals recept och få maten hemkörd.

domain.description: Hostname of the ad landing page, with leading www. stripped. All tracking parameters are removed.

url.description: Destination URL of the ad. Extracted from Google's aclk redirect. All query parameters (campaign tracking) are stripped — only scheme, host and path are kept.

site_links.description: Additional quick-link sitelinks shown beneath the ad.

description.description: The result snippet/description shown below the title.
description.example: Vi har testat och jämfört de populäraste matkassarna på marknaden.

domain.description: Hostname of the result URL, with leading www. stripped.

url.description: Full URL of the result page. Google tracking parameters (gclid, srsltid, utm_*) are stripped.

date.description: Publication or last-modified date shown in the snippet, if present.

rating.description: Structured rating data extracted from rich snippets. null when no rating is shown.

site_links.description: Sitelinks shown beneath the result (featured/expanded layout).

faq_result.description: A single "People Also Ask" FAQ item.

question.example: Vilken matkasse är bäst i test?

answer.description: The expanded answer text. null when the answer was not embedded in the HTML (e.g. scripts were stripped before saving, or the page uses pure client-side lazy loading).
answer.example: Linas Matkasse toppar vår lista 2025 med höga betyg för smak och variation.

citations.description: Source links shown in the answer card, in display order.

faq_citation.description: A source link shown inside a FAQ answer card.

position.description: 1-based position of this citation within the FAQ answer.

title.description: The page title of the cited source.

domain.description: Hostname of the cited page, with leading www. stripped.

url.description: Full URL of the cited page.

site_link.description: A sitelink shown beneath an organic result or ad.

position.description: 1-based position within the sitelinks list for this result.

url.description: Full URL of the sitelink destination.

rating.description: Rich-snippet rating data extracted from an organic result.

max_score.description: The maximum possible score (always 5 unless the snippet states otherwise).

number_of_ratings.description: How many ratings the score is based on.
